 Summary Statement
 Obligation to provide a confidential report has been met and all initial reporting and compliance measures have been taken to comply with the Conflict of Interest Act .
 Divestment of Publicly Traded Securities by the establishment of blind trust(s)
 Divestment of Stock options/Warrants/Rights and similar instruments by the establishment of blind trust(s)
 Agreed Compliance Measures
 WHEREAS by reason of my appointment on June 3, 2020 as a federal reporting public office holder, I am subject to the Conflict of Interest Act (“Act”), including its prohibition on holding controlled assets (section
17).
WHEREAS I have opted to divest my controlled assets, namely 333 Class “F4” shares in the capital of O.R.M. Ltd., by placing them into a blind trust, in accordance with section 27 of the Act. 
WHEREAS O.R.M. Ltd. (the corporation) is a private holding corporation that holds investments in controlled assets as defined by section 20 of the Act.
AND WHEREAS pursuant to section 29 of the Act, the Conflict of Interest and Ethics Commissioner (Commissioner) has determined that the following additional compliance measures are required in order for
me to comply with the requirements of the Act:
1. I shall not instruct, direct or advise the corporation’s directors, officers or shareholders (including the Trustees of the Macklem Family Trust) or anyone else acting on the corporation’s behalf, with respect to the corporation’s controlled assets, including the management, disposition or investment of those assets.
2. I shall refuse all requests for discussion, consultation, instruction, direction or advice by the corporation’s directors, officers, shareholders, or by anyone else acting on the corporation’s behalf, with respect to the corporation’s controlled assets. I will also refuse any information offered to me by the directors, officers, and shareholders of the corporation about the corporation’s controlled assets.
3. Any person or entity, including any director, officer, or shareholder of the corporation who communicates with me in respect of the corporation’s controlled assets shall be directed by me to the Trustee of my blind trust.
